name: Ochita Seijo-tachi ~Todokanakatta Inori~
original_name: 堕ちた聖女達 ～届かなかった祈り～
source:
We lived lives of prayer and work at a nunnery on the outskirts of town. It was a peaceful and fulfilling existence. 

"Have you gotten used to things here yet, Sister Naomi?"

"Yes, of course, sister… As if! I could never get used to a place like this…"

I don't know what kind of life Naomi lived before she became a nun... I can't say our lives at the nunnery were very exciting, but I hope that one day, Naomi understands the value of a peaceful life.

However, one day, the nunnery was assaulted by a group of armed men... Our days of work and prayer were smashed to pieces. The sisters were kidnapped by our assailants.

My name is Yuri, and I'm one of the captives.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4118730/]Steam[/url]]
